items.title: AI Agent Workspace Architecture
items.title_zh: 跨设备本机优先 Agent 工作系统架构全景图
items.alt: 跨设备本机优先 Agent 工作系统架构全景图，展示入口、本机 Git 主源、只读投影、工具、备份与任务流
items.goal: Explain the layers, boundaries, memory capabilities, tools, sources of truth and end-to-end task flow of an Agent workspace.
items.copy_prompt: Visualize our cross-device Agent workspace for product and engineering leadership. Show users and Agents, access, memory and context, external tools, sources of truth, the task flow, and governing principles.

items.title: Multi-Agent Execution Loop
items.alt: Agent 任务执行闭环，展示规划、上下文、工具、验证与学习反馈
items.goal: Explain how an Agent plans, builds context, requests missing information, uses tools, verifies output and learns.
items.copy_prompt: Show our Agent execution loop from user intent through planning, context construction, tool execution, verification, delivery and learning feedback. Make the missing-information branch explicit.

items.title: RAG & Real-time Data Flow
items.alt: 实时智能数据流，展示采集、治理、计算、存储、模型服务与反馈
items.goal: Trace governed data from source systems to real-time compute, historical storage, model serving and product feedback.
items.copy_prompt: Map our RAG and real-time AI data flow. Separate sources, ingestion and governance, compute and storage, model serving, product experience, and the learning feedback path.

items.title: AI Product Capability Map
items.alt: AI 产品能力地图，从产品北极星连接核心能力与价值结果
items.goal: Connect the product north star to platform capabilities, governance and measurable outcomes.
items.copy_prompt: Create a capability map for our AI product. Start with the north star, organize the core capability domains, and connect each domain to the customer or business outcomes it enables.

items.title: Software Release Swimlane
items.alt: AI 功能发布泳道，展示产品、安全与工程团队之间的审批和交付
items.goal: Make ownership, approval, implementation, evidence, staged release and rework visible across teams.
items.copy_prompt: Visualize our release process as swimlanes for product, security and engineering. Show the approval gate, implementation, evidence, staged release and the rework loop with explicit ownership.

items.title: Highly Available AI Service Topology
items.title_zh: 高可用 AI 服务拓扑
items.alt: 高可用 AI 服务拓扑，展示边缘、服务、数据和可观测性平面
items.goal: Show runtime dependencies and synchronous, asynchronous, control and observability paths across service planes.
items.copy_prompt: Show the runtime topology of our highly available AI service. Separate edge, service, data and observability planes, and distinguish synchronous requests, asynchronous work and telemetry paths.

items.title: AI Assistant First-Activation User Flow
items.title_zh: AI 助手首次激活用户流程
items.alt: AI 助手首次激活用户流程，展示价值理解、授权、首次成功、持续使用和不确定性恢复
items.goal: Explain how a new user moves from product discovery to first success and repeat use, including an uncertainty recovery path.
items.copy_prompt: Show the first-activation user flow for our AI assistant. Include discovery, value understanding, a readiness decision, scoped workspace connection, first success, repeat use, and a recovery path for uncertain users.
